name: R.G.A. Services & Cleaning
summary: R.G.A. Services & Cleaning (Israel) 1987 Ltd offers a comprehensive range of services to municipal departments overseeing public works, sanitation, and environmental quality. The company specializes in essential urban maintenance, including street sweeping, the deployment of mechanical cleaning equipment, and efficient garbage and debris removal for local authorities. Its clientele also extends to public, educational, and governmental institutions, as well as the public transportation sector. Operating across Israel, the firm serves numerous cities and localities such as Tiberias, Hadera, Netanya, Ramat Hasharon, Ramat Gan, Holon, Tel Aviv, Rishon LeZion, Ramla, Bat Yam, Kfar Saba, Beer Sheva, Jerusalem, Herzliya, and Bnei Brak, among others. Established in 1987, the company's main office is located in Giv'at Shmuel, Israel. Effective February 6, 2025, R.G.A. Services & Cleaning (Israel) 1987 Ltd functions as a subsidiary of Value Capital One Ltd.
